User.title: User Profile
User.description: User preferences and system-wide setting indicators.

userId.description: The firebase auth unique user identifier

email.description: Email address of the operator user

offlineMode.description: Local cached mode bypass trigger flag

createdAt.description: Timestamp when user profile was instantiated

Plant.title: Plant Profile
Plant.description: Botanical specimen parameters, structural metrics, and sensor records.

name.description: Custom name assigned to this specimen

health.description: Computed health status of the plant

height.description: Current specimen height metric in centimeters

lastWatered.description: Timestamp of last detected watering trigger

aiOptimized.description: Whether automated Gemini care triggers are enabled

esp32DeviceId.description: Paired ESP32 sensor hardware device serial node

ESP32Device.title: ESP32 Device Node
ESP32Device.description: Paired remote wireless GPIO hardware sensor micro-processor node.

id.description: Identifier token of the ESP32 node

status.description: Hardware node online heartbeat connection status

lastSeen.description: ISO timestamp of last telemetry broadcast check-in

ActivityLog.title: Actuation and Care Activity Log
ActivityLog.description: Chronological record of manual watering, system notifications, or AI-driven interventions.

timestamp.description: Timestamp when this event log was executed

/users/{userId}.description: Main user collection holding configuration preferences.

/users/{userId}/plants/{plantId}.description: Individual plants listed under the given user profile.

/users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}.description: Paired ESP32 sensor hardware nodes registered under the user profile.

/users/{userId}/activities/{activityId}.description: Action and automation log histories synced to Firestore.
